page: OVHcloud b3-8 is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor running at 2.3 GHz, configured with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs with 1 thread per core. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 50 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25%. However, multi-core performance is average, and several multi-threaded or complex workloads show limitations. For instance, Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing benchmarks fall into the bottom 25%. Memory performance is mixed; while large block read and write bandwidths are average, small block cached read bandwidth and Passmark memory scores are weak.

The instance exhibits poor performance in static web serving throughput, placing in the bottom 10%, and weak database operations, making it less suitable for high-traffic web servers or intensive database hosting. Large language model inference is also constrained, with medium 7B model prompt processing scoring in the bottom 10%. Consequently, the b3-8 is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic text processing, single-threaded applications, and development environments that do not require high network throughput or massive parallel processing.
